standard.summary: T-GATE 方向是在推理后段跳过深层 text cross-attention。当前 Lulynx 只做 observe-only 计数。
standard.effect: tgate_start_step 和 tgate_min_block 只影响 would-skip 统计，不改变 attention 输出。
standard.whenToUse: 需要判断后续是否值得做 attention skip 时。
standard.avoidWhen: 期待当前开关直接省时；真实 skip 路径尚未打开。

standard_en.summary: The T-GATE direction is to skip deep text cross-attention late in inference. Lulynx currently does observe-only counting.
standard_en.effect: tgate_start_step and tgate_min_block only affect the would-skip statistics; they do not change the attention output.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you need to judge whether an attention skip would be worth building later.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you expect this switch to save time as it stands; the real skip path is not open yet.

advanced.principle: 记录 self/cross-attention 位置和满足条件的候选 block。
advanced.intervention: GenerationRequest → sampler context → Anima attention telemetry。
advanced.expectedImpact: 当前无可宣称推理性能收益；后续若跳过深层 cross-attention 才可能降低 token 计算。
advanced.tradeoffs: 不能和 Spectrum 一样被当作已完成的加速开关。

advanced_en.principle: Records self/cross-attention positions and candidate blocks meeting the conditions.
advanced_en.intervention: GenerationRequest → sampler context → Anima attention telemetry.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No claimable inference performance benefit currently; only once deep cross-attention can be skipped might token compute drop.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: It must not be treated as a finished acceleration switch the way Spectrum is.
